digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review gates documentation and CLI/MCP explain interface
propositions: Authors cannot easily discover how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate; existing material covers only gate mechanics or reviewer-facing criteria, not author guidance.
The code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified) lacks author-facing on-ramp documentation, creating the same discoverability gap as the plan-review gate.
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the criterion registry for the description template rather than to author-facing guidance.
The rebar explain CLI and MCP explain_criterion tool must support author-guide lookups (e.g., `rebar explain plan`, `rebar explain review`) alongside criterion-id lookups, via a shared registry.
New hand-written prose on-ramp docs must be indexed and linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
